content:
Apple TV’s hit series The Studio has consistently won every major award this season, and now it’s achieved something historic that no comedy ever has before.

The Studio is the first comedy ever to sweep all major awards

The Studio season 2 is being filmed right now, but last year’s season 1 continues racking up acclaim.

Apple’s hit comedy has won every major award it’s been nominated for to this point. That includes:

  • Outstanding Comedy at the Emmy Awards
  • Best Comedy at the Golden Globes
  • Best Comedy at the Critics Choice Awards
  • and more

And now, The Studio has also won the International award from the 2026 British Academy of Film and Television Arts (BAFTA). It beat out fellow nominees The Bear, The Diplomat, The White Lotus, and Apple’s own Pluribus and Severance.

This win makes The Studio, per Apple, “the first comedy in history to sweep all major awards in a single season.”

“The historic journey of ‘The Studio’ has been nothing short of astounding,” said Matt Cherniss, Apple TV’s head of programming. “The show’s sweeping success is a testament to the extraordinary talent, creativity and innovation of Seth, Evan and the entire creative team and cast. The series has resonated deeply with audiences worldwide, bringing laughter to millions. We couldn’t be prouder of the team’s monumental achievement and the way ‘The Studio’ has redefined what’s possible for comedy on a global scale.”

No announcement has been made yet regarding season 2’s timing. The Studio season 1 aired in spring 2025.

Here’s hoping we see the show return this fall. At the latest though, season 2 should premiere in early 2027.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.
